title: Archive through December 19, 2002 - Anonymous (Sunday, December 8, 2002 - 01:08 pm)
content: I saw myself on a couch. I had lost alot of blood because of internal hemorrhaging. I saw a bright light, and I had never had such a feeling of complete peace. I did not know who I could tell this event to. It was such an incredible experience. I sometimes feel that I should tell people so that they would know how wonderful it was.
